title.narrative: Focused and differentiated HIV prevention and treatment in Sudan

description.narrative: Sudan - HIV. This program has the following goals: Eliminate HIV in Sudan as a public health threat by 2030.. The objectives of this program are: To increase Coverage of key populations with the integrated package of preventive and treatment services (NSP ER 2.1.). To define, structure, and use the Community Health Workers to expand access to integrated PHC services including for HIV, TB and Malaria.. To increase Coverage of quality ART services (NSP ER3.2.). To support the country to strengthen the IDSR, community and sentinel surveillance components in the nine (9) priority states.. To improve Dignity and quality of life of people living with HIV is (NSP PA 6). To support surge capacity through procurement of high impact items (PSA plants and solar panels) to support a decentralized health system and respond to needs of the current emergency context.. To improve Functionality of the monitoring & evaluation system to strategically inform the HIV response
